vocabulary.meaning_en: the hottest season of the year
vocabulary.example: Summer in Washington is hot and sunny.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to travel on a bus, train, bike or horse
vocabulary.example: I always ride the Metro to work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the underground train in a city
vocabulary.note_ar: في لندن يسمونه the Underground، وفي نيويورك the subway.
vocabulary.note_en: In London it is the Underground; in New York, the subway.
vocabulary.example: The Metro is cool and fast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not open
vocabulary.example: The Metro is closed today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after the right time
vocabulary.example: I am late this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get to a place
vocabulary.note_ar: arrive at + مكان صغير، arrive in + مدينة/بلد
vocabulary.note_en: arrive at a building, arrive in a city
vocabulary.example: When you arrive, please come to my office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room or building where people work at desks
vocabulary.example: Please come to my office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having great value or meaning
vocabulary.example: I have important news to tell you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: information that makes you happy
vocabulary.note_ar: news غير معدود: نقول good news وليس a good news
vocabulary.note_en: News is uncountable: not 'a good news'.
vocabulary.example: I have good news: you have a new job!

vocabulary.meaning_en: information that makes you sad or worried
vocabulary.example: The bad news is the shop is closed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell someone they cannot work for you anymore
vocabulary.example: Don't worry. I am not firing you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the seventh month of the year
vocabulary.note_en: Months start with a capital letter.
vocabulary.example: Next month is July.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the eighth month of the year
vocabulary.example: It is very hot in August.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the ninth month of the year
vocabulary.example: School starts in September.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one of the twelve parts of a year
vocabulary.example: You start next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something well
vocabulary.note_ar: بعدها اسم أو فعل بـ ing
vocabulary.note_en: Followed by a noun or a verb + -ing.
vocabulary.example: You are good at talking to people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: funny in a childish way; not serious
vocabulary.example: The children make silly faces.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a meaning; to want to say
vocabulary.note_ar: What does it mean? = ماذا يعني ذلك؟
vocabulary.example: What does this word mean?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a job or piece of work that someone gives you
vocabulary.example: I have a new assignment for you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an ability to do something well
vocabulary.example: Your skills are perfect for this job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; exactly right
vocabulary.example: This weather is perfect for a walk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a TV program made for children
vocabulary.example: Anna will work on a children's show.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thought or plan
vocabulary.note_ar: tons of ideas = أفكار كثيرة جدًا
vocabulary.note_en: tons of ideas = very many ideas
vocabulary.example: I have tons of ideas!

vocabulary.meaning_en: the area far above the Earth, where the stars are
vocabulary.example: Astronauts travel to outer space.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very large area of salt water
vocabulary.example: Many fish live in the deep, dark ocean.

fine_lines.title: good at vs good for
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good at = ماهر في شيء: She is good at math. أما good for = مفيد لشيء: Walking is good for you.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Good at means you do something well: She is good at math. Good for means helpful or healthy: Walking is good for you.

examples.sentence: You are good at asking questions.

fine_lines.title: late vs early
fine_lines.explanation_ar: late = بعد الوقت المطلوب. early = قبل الوقت المطلوب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Late is after the right time. Early is before the right time.

examples.sentence: I am late because the Metro is closed.

expressions.example: The museum is closed today. - That's too bad.

expressions.phrase: I have important news to tell you.
expressions.meaning_ar: لديّ خبر مهم أريد أن أخبرك به.
expressions.meaning_en: I need to tell you something big.
expressions.example: Sit down. I have important news to tell you.

expressions.phrase: I have good news and bad news.
expressions.meaning_en: Some of my news is good and some is bad.
expressions.example: I have good news and bad news. Which do you want first?

expressions.phrase: Which do you want to hear first?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking someone to choose one first.
expressions.example: Good news or bad news: which do you want to hear first?

expressions.phrase: I am very sorry to hear that.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite answer to bad news.
expressions.example: My brother is sick. - I'm very sorry to hear that.

expressions.meaning_en: Please explain what you are saying.
expressions.example: You say I'm good at many things. What does all that mean?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking the start time of a new job or task.
expressions.example: I love this new job! When do I start?
Can you come to my office? - Of course.
A school trip? I have tons of ideas!

expressions.phrase: The important thing is to know what you are good at.
expressions.meaning_ar: الشيء المهم أن تعرف ما الذي تُجيده.
expressions.meaning_en: It matters to know your skills.
expressions.example: Everyone has skills. The important thing is to know what you are good at.

grammar.title: be good at + noun / verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم be good at لنقول إن شخصًا ماهر في شيء. 2) بعد at نضع اسمًا: good at math، أو فعلًا بـ ing: good at asking questions. 3) لا نضع المصدر مع to بعد at (لا نقول good at to ask). 4) يمكن قول great at أو not good at.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use be good at to say someone does something well. 2) After at, use a noun (good at math) or a verb + -ing (good at asking questions). 3) Never use to + verb after at. 4) You can also say great at or not good at.
examples: You are good at talking to people.
You are great at being silly.
You are not good at reading the news.
My sister is good at drawing.

grammar.title: Months of the year and 'in' + month
grammar.explanation_ar: الشهور: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. تبدأ بحرف كبير، ونستخدم in قبلها: in July. ونقول next month و last month بدون حرف جر.
grammar.explanation_en: The months are January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. They start with a capital letter. Use in: in July. Say next month and last month with no preposition.
examples: I am not firing you in July.

grammar.title: Talking about the future: You start / You will not read
grammar.explanation_ar: للحديث عن المستقبل المخطط يمكن استخدام المضارع البسيط لجدول ثابت (You start next month) أو will not + فعل للنفي (You will not read the news). ونسأل: When do I start?
grammar.explanation_en: To talk about a planned future, use the simple present for a timetable (You start next month) or will / will not + verb (You will not read the news). Ask: When do I start?
examples: When do I start? - You start next month.
Starting next month, you will not read the news.

questions.question: You are good at ___ questions.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد good at نضع فعلًا بـ ing.

questions.question: Your friend says, 'I lost my job.' You say:
choices: I'm very sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation_ar: نردّ على الخبر السيئ بـ I'm very sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation_en: We answer bad news with I'm very sorry to hear that.

questions.question: A job or piece of work that someone gives you is an ___.
questions.explanation_en: An assignment is a job someone gives you.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: news غير معدود، فلا نقول a news.

questions.question: Walking every day is good ___ you.
questions.explanation_ar: good for = مفيد لـ. good at = ماهر في.
questions.explanation_en: Good for means healthy or helpful; good at means skilled.

questions.question: 'Fire' in 'I am not firing you' means:
questions.explanation_ar: fire هنا تعني يطرد من العمل.
questions.explanation_en: Here fire means to make someone leave their job.

questions.question: Anna is not on time. She is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Late means after the right time.
